channel.title: The daily tape · compute.world
channel.description: Texas power paper and a named Georgia tenant share the overnight print, while the Silicon Tape stays flat. RWE Americas said on 17 Sep it signed a 433 MW virtual PPA with Oracle from existing Panther Creek I–III wind in Sterling, Howard and Glasscock counties — framed as part of Oracle’s broader Texas portfolio of more than 1.7 GW supporting data-center load on ERCOT. Same day CleanSpark’s investor materials named Meta subsidiary Anviran LLC as the tenant on the previously announced 175 MW Sandersville, Georgia AI lease (~$6.6B initial-term revenue), with a PR Newswire pitch for $2.227B senior notes due 2031 to finish the campus (offering not closed). PUCT Project 58481 remains HOLD: Interchange still shows 217 filings and no stamped Order Adopting after the 18 Sep open meeting agenda. The Silicon Tape is another clean confirm: Lambda H100 $3.99 and B200 $6.69 unchanged across 69 re-read list prints.

Countries: United States / Texas: RWE×Oracle 433 MW VPPA (Panther Creek I–III) announced 17 Sep; part of Oracle’s >1.7 GW Texas power book for AI DC ops. Australia / Queensland: Anthropic×Zerra Western Downs lease (16 Sep) still FIRB + council gated; path ~2.16 GW peak.
